text:
Noah: Quick sync on roles panel updates — dropping new mocks, focus is making the legend easier to scan for admins.

Maya: Saw them. Main issues: legend gets visually heavy with many roles, and SSO toggle helptext is verbose and pushes content below the fold.

Oliver: Could compress long descriptions into compact pills and reveal details on demand.

Hana: Accessibility note: hover-only reveal is no-go. Expanders must be keyboard operable with aria-expanded, focus ring, and readable contrast.

Maya: Pattern idea: pill with name + mini badge, chevron button to expand an inline details region. Chevron should be a real button with aria-controls.

Sam: From engineering: lazy-render details for large orgs and animate height to reduce layout shift. Ensure focus is applied after animation ends.

Oliver: I'll mock two patterns: inline expander (chevrons) and an alternative side-panel (less layout shift).

Noah: SSO copy tweak: keep it short. Draft: "Enforce SSO for everyone — recommended." Add a tertiary link "Why this matters" to open a modal.

Hana: Modal requirements: focus trap, programmatic focus to title (tabindex=-1), Esc to close. Include audit log implications in the body.

Oliver: Users can't find SSO events today. Proposal: add a quick-filter CTA near the toggle: "View SSO events" that deep-links to /orgs/:id/audit with filter event_type:sso.enforce.

Sam: Backend already tags events with event_type: sso.enforce. Frontend deep-link will URL-encode the filter. I'll wire it.

Maya: Flow when toggling SSO on: show confirmation/rollout panel; it must receive focus, and primary CTA should read "Start SSO rollout".

Hana: Make the panel title an h2 with tabindex=-1 and focus it after expand. Ensure tab order goes title -> primary CTA -> secondary CTA -> rest.

Sam: Also add aria-live for success/failure to announce rollout start. Debounce focus calls for quick toggles.

Oliver: I'll attach keyboard interaction states and a 160ms motion spec. Will include side-panel alt for comparison.

design-bot: Mock uploaded: https://figma.redwood.com/file/abc123/roles-compact-pills ":thumbsup:"

Maya: I'll run a 5-person usability test next week measuring time-to-find SSO events and clarity of the legend.

Noah: Action items: Oliver update mocks (inline + side-panel); Hana write accessibility checklist for expanders/tooltips/modal; Sam implement deep-link + focus prototype; Maya schedule tests. Follow-up after results.
